title: Lazarus Group-linked addresses move $30M through Hyperliquid
summary: Crypto wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group moved $30 million in digital assets through Hyperliquid, weeks after regulators said they were working on a path to introduce the exchange into US markets.

title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
summary: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.

title: Bitfinex Securities lists tokenized notes tied to Strategy, Metaplanet
summary: Five equity-backed notes issued through Luxembourg’s ORO II fund will trade against dollars, USDT and Bitcoin for eligible non-US investors.

title: Singapore weighs recognizing some foreign-issued stablecoins
summary: Singapore is considering allowing jointly issued cross-border stablecoins into its regulatory regime, revisiting its earlier decision to restrict the framework to domestic issuance.

title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
summary: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.

title: BlackRock drives $217M Bitcoin ETF rebound as altcoin funds continue streaks
summary: Ether ETFs extended their inflow streak to 11 trading sessions, while XRP and Solana funds each logged a 10th consecutive positive session.

title: Thailand SEC proposes retail access to regulated overseas crypto derivatives
summary: Thailand’s SEC seeks comments on rules requiring retail-accessible overseas crypto derivatives to trade on qualifying, centrally cleared exchanges.

title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
summary: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
summary: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.
